## Summary

Describe the problem, the change and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

Describe the focused tests and other checks performed. For hardware checks,
state the generation and distinguish observed behavior from acknowledgements.

- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change.
- [ ] I updated documentation, translations and release notes where needed.
- [ ] This is a documentation-only change; I checked links and examples.

## Privacy and compatibility

- [ ] I removed credentials, private URLs, robot identifiers and private logs.
- [ ] I considered supported server versions, Gen3/Gen4 behavior and existing settings.
